The '''Special Investigations squad''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]] established by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Tren Pergallis]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stassia]]. Members of the unit included [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Zeck Tambell]] and [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Valon Rizz]], who was the first [[Stassian]] to be appointed to the [[Squad/Legends|squad]].<ref name="Ringers">{{JournalCite|6|Ringers (short story)}}</ref>
